name: Awbrey Glen Golf Club

nadir.desc: The property consists of a large golf course facility with multiple fairways, greens, sand traps, and a pond|A large clubhouse building and parking areas are located at one end of the site|Dense mature trees are present throughout and around the perimeter of the course.

alpha.desc: Fairways and greens extend outward from the building|Trees and landscaping are visible around the entrance and parking areas|The clubhouse sits in front of  parking lot, centrally situated

bravo.desc: The left side of the property shows portions of the golf course, including fairways and a pond|The clubhouse and parking areas are visible|Trees are scattered throughout.

charlie.desc: The rear of the facility shows additional golf course holes, fairways, and greens|Trees are scattered throughout the course area|The clubhouse and parking are visible in the distance.

delta.desc: The right side of the property shows extensive golf course layout with fairways, greens, and tree coverage|The clubhouse complex is visible along with parking areas.

considerations: Vehicle access is available via parking lots adjacent to the main clubhouse building. The large open golf course areas provide significant space for movement and staging. Scattered tree coverage throughout the course and along the perimeter may limit visibility in some sections. The layout allows relatively good access around the clubhouse and main parking areas, though movement across the course itself could be affected by terrain, water features, and tree clusters.
clarifications: Where are the primary vehicle entrances to the parking areas, and are any of them gated or restricted? Is there a designated fire lane or emergency vehicle access route around the clubhouse? Are there multiple points of entry into the main clubhouse building? Are there any gates or barriers controlling access to specific areas of the golf course? What other structures or facilities are located on the property besides the main clubhouse? How do the surrounding areas and roads affect access or staging during an emergency response?
